notes.subject: bɛ
notes.rationale: Heburukan tɛ kɛ-daɲɛ sɔrɔ; Bamanankan b'a de wajibiya sankolo-yɔrɔ la

notes.subject: sanfɛ jɔnaw
notes.rationale: במרומים kɔrɔ ye 'sanfɛ jɔyɔrɔ caman' ye — sankolo-jɔlenw, kana 'sanba' kɛ

notes.subject: seere
notes.rationale: Yobu ka seere in ye Yawe ye, walima Eloah, walima ala-sɔrɔli min tɛ ye — ayɔrɔ dɔ kunbɛn kɔfɛ (Yobu 19:25)

translation: Hali bi, aw ye, ne ka seere ⟨bɛ⟩ sankolow la, ani min bɛ seere ne ye, o ⟨bɛ⟩ sanfɛ jɔnaw la.

tokens.gloss: ani min bɛ seere ne ye
